description: Inputs consumed by scripts/build_statistics.py for the cluster-bootstrap intervals, paired tests and null bands.
records: data/v2/metrics_<split stem>.json and data/v2/null_<split stem>.json, written by scripts/recompute_all.sh (headline cells picked on validation by linear_trainer.records)
run_marker: data/v2/run_complete.json (one whole-manifest run, one commit and protocol)
stored_predictions: outputs/predictions/v2/<split stem>/<cell>__<task>[__shufN]__<sha12>.npz (each record's pred_file, verified against pred_sha256), plus targets__<sha16>.npz for GenePT targets
resampling_groups: data/clusters/homology_id40.tsv (CDS on homology-type splits); window-and-protein groups from splits.tss_disjoint (TSS cells and disjoint splits)
